column1: # The neighbour of a unit by near (P/04 N1.3; ADR-0091 item 10). Form — README.

column4: by and of: my field by = the field of of the neighbour
there is no neighbour with my value
my field by is absent — equal to nothing, and to an absent field of the neighbour too
without prefer, between two — by id
the order — UTF-8 bytes: Z before a
prefer — OR over the list of values
two matching prefer — by id among them, not among all
prefer — AND over the fields; true is compared with "true" of the row
prefer did not match — the neighbour is chosen anyway (prefer is an order, not a filter)
none matched prefer — by id among all
the prefer path — a step along the neighbour's reference field to the row that it names
there is no target row — the path has no value, did not match
prefer with scalars: equality on each field, AND over the fields — as affinity.strict (C04-NEAR-PREFER-SCALAR-01)
